text:
Nina: Heads-up: EdgeWorks wants clarity on how we treat buffered device replays vs credits. They commonly replay up to 72h, sometimes 7d. Can we decide policy?

Omar: We should accept replays and dedupe by (batch_id OR sequence_number). Fallback dedupe: sha256(device_id + ':' + hour_bucket).

Priya: Proposal: default grace_window = 72h for automatic dedupe/no double-billing. Partner-specific override up to 7d with legal sign-off.

edgeworks-integration: We will include batch_id OR seq_num and X-Partner-Signature. Payload example: {"device_id":"ew-21","timestamp":"2026-03-20T10:00:00Z","cpu_hours":0.5,"batch_id":"b-20260320-10"}. We can also provide hourly rollups.

Sam: Implementation notes: ledger rows must store partner_id, hashed_device_id, usage_units, source_batch_id, seq_num, original_ts, ingest_ts, dedupe_key. Upsert semantics: if dedupe_key exists ignore; if later seq_num within grace_window differs, emit adjustment record (no immediate invoice change until cycle close).

BillingBot: Auto-action: create FIN ticket if adjustment_pending >0 for partner after daily reconcile.

Nina: API responses: 202 Accepted (with batch_id + received_count), 400 malformed, 401 bad signature, 409 batch already processed, 422 missing replay id when replay flag set.

Omar: Metrics: partner.replays.received, partner.replays.duplicates, partner.adjustments.created, partner.reconciliation.delta. PagerDuty on delta spikes.

Priya: Action items: edgeworks-integration to send public key + confirm batch/seq usage (ETA 2d). Omar: idempotency helper lib + docs (ETA 3d). Sam: ledger schema + adjustment queue (ETA 5d). Nina: draft partner runbook and contract appendix (ETA 4d).

edgeworks-integration: Confirmed public key upload and we will include batch_id for all replays. Thanks!
